owner.name: Nora Bishop
owner.heading: Why we started Hearth & Home
owner.bio: Nora Bishop spent a long stretch driving forty minutes each way to check on her grandmother after a fall made living alone harder than anyone wanted to admit. She found the daily visits, the meals, the company — the small things that add up to someone being okay — impossible to coordinate around a full-time job and a family of her own. Hearth & Home is the service she wishes had existed then: a small, steady team families can actually rely on, not a call center or a rotating cast of strangers.

pricing.label: Overnight & 24-Hour Care
features: A caregiver in the home overnight

faq.a: No. Hearth & Home provides non-medical companion care — help around the house, company, transportation, and support with daily routines. If your family needs skilled nursing or medical care, we're glad to help point you toward a home-health agency that can.

faq.q: How do you match a caregiver to our family?
faq.a: We start with an in-person conversation about your routines, needs and preferences, then introduce a caregiver we think is a good fit — and we check in with you regularly to make sure the match is working.

faq.q: Can the care plan change over time?
faq.a: Yes — most families start with one or two visits a week and adjust as needs change. Nothing here is a long-term contract you're locked into.

faq.q: What if we just need companionship, nothing else?
faq.a: That's plenty. Companionship-only visits are one of our most requested plans — someone to talk to, play cards with, or just be in the house.

faq.q: How quickly can we get started?
faq.a: A free in-home consultation is usually within a few days, and most families have a caregiver matched and a first visit scheduled within a week after that.

We provide medication reminders — a gentle nudge at the right time — but we don't administer medication or manage prescriptions. That's the role of a home-health or nursing service, and we're happy to help you find one if that's what's needed.
